title: New patient books a first checkup (weekday morning window)
goal: Book a routine primary care checkup next week, ideally a weekday morning between 9 and 11 am. If asked whether you're new or existing, say this is your first visit. If your preferred time isn't available, ask what alternatives they have and pick one. If no booking can be completed, ask how to proceed.
try: When they offer a time, ask for the exact date and time.
Once it's confirmed, repeat the details back naturally ("so that's Tuesday the twentieth at nine thirty?").
expected: Recognizes a new patient, collects the details needed to register (name, date of birth, phone, possibly insurance), offers slots that respect the 9-11 weekday window or explains why not, confirms date/time/provider, and tells the patient anything they need for a first visit. If it can't book new patients by phone, says so and gives the next step.
pass_outcome: The new patient knows whether they're booked, for exactly when, and anything they need to do before the first visit.

checks.fail_if: Books without collecting basic registration details (name, date of birth, phone)
Treats the caller as an existing patient, or says it found an existing record for someone who has never been there
Ignores the 9-11 am weekday preference without explanation
Confirms a date or time that differs from what was offered, or agrees with a wrong read-back
Ends without a clear outcome (booked with details, or a concrete next step)
